k2_form_used: day-level BIC n_d ln(RSSw/n_d) + (2K+1) ln n_d, n_d=126; weights 1/(sb2+sw2/m_d) normalised to mean 1; sb2 by ANOVA moments from K0 residuals. Author: sb2 = mean(dm^2 - sw2/m) (simpler MoM, same penalty n=126, unnormalised weights): compatible.

flips_to_pass: none. K1 fails D5b (c) (0.12, upper 0.17); K2 fails S2 (0.135), S4 (0.135) and D5b (0.105) (c); K3 fails (a) D5b (0.74, and S4 untested here). K1 passes S4 (c) on my stream (0.09, author 0.135) but remains inadmissible via D5b. Verdict 'no admissible rule' reproduced; K1 is the closest, margin 0.02 over the gate in D5b.
